title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations Rate Card Note: Window Share for an Alignment Comeback Credit
content:
The window share applied to an alignment comeback credit on an ADAS Sensor Calibrations customer-pay order is **0.50** where the comeback window is no more than 30 days, **0.35** where it is more than 30 but no more than 90 days, and **0.20** otherwise.

## The window, in the words of the records

The comeback window runs from the delivered date of the vehicle's network insurance claim repair — read from the vehicle's Insurance Claim Repairs record — to the end of the window on the calibration order. Days are calendar days counted from the earlier date to the later date, the earlier date not counted. Where the vehicle has no delivered network insurance claim repair on record, the window is taken as 99999 days, and the share is 0.20.

## Share by window length

| Comeback window (calendar days) | Window share |
|---|---|
| no more than 30 | 0.50 |
| more than 30, no more than 90 | 0.35 |
| more than 90 | 0.20 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Claim repair delivered | Window ends | Days | Share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 31 March | 30 | 0.50 |
| 1 March | 1 April | 31 | 0.35 |
| 1 March | 30 May | 90 | 0.35 |
| 1 March | 31 May | 91 | 0.20 |

## Illustration (hypothetical amount figured on of 100.00 USD)

The share takes 50.00 USD of it at 0.50, 35.00 USD at 0.35 and 20.00 USD at 0.20.
